description.value: Event-related passive viewing of paintings presented with either a sponsoring or nonsponsoring company logo, followed after scanning by subjective preference ratings.

instructions.value: Passively view each painting during scanning; after scanning, rate subjective preference for each image on a Likert scale from +3 to −3.

stimuli.value: Sixty unfamiliar visual chromatic reproductions of original paintings, including 30 abstract and 30 representational paintings, paired with unfamiliar company logos.
